name: PMO Indicator Readings
query: SELECT r.name AS "Reading:Link/PMO Indicator Reading:180", r.project AS "Project:Link/PMO Project:180", r.indicator AS "Indicator:Link/PMO Indicator:200", r.reading_date AS "Reading Date:Date:120", r.value AS "Value:Float:110", r.validation_status AS "Validation:Data:110" FROM `tabPMO Indicator Reading` r ORDER BY r.reading_date DESC
